import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    bottom=g[-1]
    runs=[];i=0
    while i<w:
        if bottom[i]!=0:
            j=i
            while j<w and bottom[j]!=0: j+=1
            runs.append(bottom[i:j]); i=j
        else: i+=1
    for r in range(h-1):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            if (c>0 and g[r][c-1]!=0) or (c<w-1 and g[r][c+1]!=0): continue  # not isolated
            for seq in runs:
                if v in seq:
                    k=seq.index(v); a=c-k
                    for idx,val in enumerate(seq):
                        cc=a+idx
                        if 0<=cc<w: out[r][cc]=val
                    break
    return out
